rationale: The Latin anchors *commovere* and *movere* both carry the sense of causing something to move or be set in motion, pointing to a causative/transitive meaning. Synset move.v.02 ("cause to move or shift into a new position or place") best matches this causative sense of a-sterian, as opposed to the intransitive travel.v.01 or the purely physical self-motion of move.v.03.
